label: Bible Study
prompt: _____ in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
verse: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
note: Paul says it twice in one verse — written from prison, no less.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, _____ thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.
verse: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.
note: Even Zephaniah, prophet of the great dark Day, ends with 'fear thou not' for Zion.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five _____ stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd's bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.
verse: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd's bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.
note: Five smooth stones from the brook — David packed four more than he needed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained _____ unawares.
verse: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
note: Abraham fed three strangers by his tent and got heaven's messengers — hospitality can outrank you.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the _____ riches of Christ;
verse: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
note: 'Unsearchable riches' — wealth no audit reaches the bottom of, preached by 'less than the least.'
